name: The Hollow Lantern — Cistern (Example)
ambient: (EXAMPLE AREA — PLACEHOLDER PROSE) A brick cistern under the lighthouse. The water is low, and something has been dragging itself along the walls.

objects.name: Stairs to the Yard
objects.look: (EXAMPLE OBJECT) The stair back up to the yard. The lamp above is still dark.

interactions.label: Climb back to the yard
interactions.success_text: (EXAMPLE) You climb back into the evening air.

effects.text: (EXAMPLE ENCOUNTER) The water breaks. Two drowned shapes pull themselves upright between you and the stairs.
